description: Source code for Android video encoder acceleration using MediaCodec, including initialization, encoding, buffer management, and error handling.

classes.name: AndroidVideoEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: Implements hardware-accelerated video encoding on Android using MediaCodec, managing buffers, encoding parameters, and error reporting.

methods.name: GetSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Returns supported video encoding profiles based on device capabilities and hardcoded defaults.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the encoder with specified configuration, creating MediaCodec instance, and preparing buffers.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Queues a video frame for encoding, converting formats as needed.

methods.name: UseOutputBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Provides an output buffer for encoded data.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChange
methods.description: Requests change in encoding bitrate and framerate.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops encoding.
